ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The purple drawer holds the Germany file. ... The blue drawer holds the Turkey file. ... The brown drawer holds the Austria file. ... What colour is the drawer with the file on the country whose capital is Ankara?" -> answer org blue; the alt prompt asks about the Austria (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: brown (answer of bridge alt's statement), purple (answer at the same statement slot), pink (the alt prompt's own answer), blue (answer org kept).
